lean.statement:
theorem gaussianSmoothing_position_second_moment
    (mu : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure mu] (xstar : E) (sigma : ℝ)
    (hpos : Integrable (fun x : E => ‖x - xstar‖ ^ 2) mu) :
    let piSigma := gaussianSmoothing mu sigma
    Integrable (fun y : E => ‖y - xstar‖ ^ 2) piSigma ∧
      (∫ y : E, ‖y - xstar‖ ^ 2 ∂piSigma) =
        (∫ x : E, ‖x - xstar‖ ^ 2 ∂mu) +
          sigma ^ 2 * (Module.finrank ℝ E : ℝ)
approved_definition_context: E is a finite-dimensional complete real inner-product space with its Borel measurable structure; d is its real finrank.
gaussianSmoothing mu sigma is the pushforward of mu times a standard centered Gaussian under the addition map (x,z) to x plus sigma times z; sigma is a standard-deviation scale.
